    if line.startswith('- '):
        line = line[2:]

    if ' by ' in line:
        title_part, artists_part = line.split(' by ', 1)
        title = title_part.strip()
        artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_part.split(',')]
        old_songs.append({'title': title, 'artists': artists})

        # If no " by ", treat whole line as title with no artists? But likely all have " by "
        old_songs.append({'title': line, 'artists': []})
